title: 伊泰普水壩~Itaipu Dam
focus: 雙頻率水電系統與跨境能量協調~Dual frequency hydropower and cross border energy coordination
summary: 伊泰普提供同一水力系統連結不同電網頻率的案例。學員從同步轉速、換流損失及無功容量出發，再追蹤尾水耦合、洩洪動量、冷卻與振動，最後建立跨時區資料帳。課程把電力份額與水量分配分開處理，避免將制度安排誤認為固定物理分流比例。~Itaipu illustrates one hydraulic development linked to grids with different frequencies. Learners examine synchronous speed, converter loss and reactive capacity before tailwater coupling, spillway momentum, cooling, vibration and time-aligned records. Electrical allocation and water distribution are handled separately, preventing institutional arrangements from being mistaken for a fixed physical flow split.
history: 業主歷史記載伊泰普首部機組於一九八四年五月五日開始發電，最後兩部機組於二〇〇七年五月投入運轉。官方頻率說明指出二十部機組分成五十與六十赫茲兩組；此資料用於說明跨電網介面，不暗示兩種交流母線可以直接並聯。本課不沿用網頁中的歷史世界排名，也不把電力容量與年發電量混寫；假想的換流效率與尾水參數都另外標明，文獻年代則屬方法背景。~The owner history records first generation on 5 May 1984 and entry of the last two units in May 2007. Its frequency explanation divides twenty units between fifty and sixty hertz groups, establishing a grid-interface context rather than permission to parallel unlike AC buses. Historical world rankings are not repeated, nor is installed power confused with annual energy. Assumed converter efficiencies and tailwater parameters are identified separately, while reference publication dates describe methods rather than construction.
example: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「頻率極數與轉速」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「異頻換流能量」及「無功與視在容量」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm；第二組為 Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。~This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Frequency poles and speed, then compare the controlling variables in Asynchronous conversion energy and Reactive power and apparent capacity. The first calculation is f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm; the second is Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.

units.anchor: 頻率極數與轉速~Frequency poles and speed
units.title: 頻率極數與轉速~Frequency poles and speed
units.mechanism: 同步發電機的電氣頻率由機械轉速與磁極數共同決定，並非只靠水輪機轉得更快。比較兩種頻率時應先寫清楚總極數而非極對數，再檢查轉輪水力設計所允許的轉速。電網頻率不同不表示兩台機組的轉輪幾何可以不經分析直接互換。 磁極數選擇也影響發電機幾何與轉輪匹配，因此頻率介面應由機械與電氣團隊共同確認，不能只改控制設定。~Synchronous electrical frequency depends on mechanical speed and magnetic pole count, rather than simply making a turbine rotate faster. State total poles rather than pole pairs when comparing frequencies, then check the speed allowed by the hydraulic design. Different grid frequencies do not make runner geometries interchangeable without analysis. Pole selection also affects generator geometry and runner matching, so mechanical and electrical teams must jointly verify a frequency interface rather than merely changing control settings.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm。模型邊界：理想同步轉速，極數為總磁極數；不是伊泰普實際機組銘牌。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm. Model boundary: ideal synchronous speed using total magnetic poles, not an Itaipu machine nameplate.
units.verify: 將電氣頻率、軸轉速與銘牌極數互相核對，並檢查轉速感測器每轉脈衝設定。若頻率正確但顯示轉速倍增，先查極對數與脈衝換算，不要由儀表顯示直接推定水輪機發生超速。~Cross-check electrical frequency, shaft speed and nameplate pole count, including pulses per revolution in the tachometer. If frequency is correct but displayed speed doubles, investigate pole-pair conventions and pulse conversion before interpreting the display as physical turbine overspeed.
units.failure: 總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。~Mixing poles with pole pairs creates a factor-of-two speed error that propagates into torque and centrifugal calculations. The synchronous relation applies after synchronization; startup and disconnected transients cannot be forced to follow it.
units.misconception: 只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯~Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency.
units.practice: 用相同總極數計算另一頻率的轉速，並畫出轉速與頻率關係，再說明若維持原轉速，所需極數為何必須是可製造的整數配置。~Calculate speed at another frequency using the same total poles. Plot the relationship and explain why retaining the original speed requires an integer pole arrangement that can actually be constructed.

units.anchor: 異頻換流能量~Asynchronous conversion energy
units.title: 異頻換流能量~Asynchronous conversion energy
units.mechanism: 不同頻率的交流系統可藉電力電子換流傳輸能量，但換流站會產生損失並受控制及設備限制。教材以輸入電量乘總效率求接收電量，只描述能量帳，不把它當成電壓穩定或故障穿越分析。每個效率都要附邊界，避免把線路損失同時算入兩次。 換流損失可包含固定輔助耗電及隨負載改變的部分，低負載效率因此未必與額定點相同，需保留負載曲線。~Power-electronic conversion can transfer energy between AC systems of different frequencies, with losses and equipment constraints. Multiplying input energy by overall efficiency describes the energy account only, not voltage stability or fault behavior. Each efficiency needs a boundary so that line losses are not included twice in the same transfer estimate. Conversion losses can include fixed auxiliaries and load-dependent components, making low-load efficiency differ from the rated point; retain the load curve in comparisons.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。模型邊界：固定輸入及總傳輸效率，未計動態限制與停機。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh. Model boundary: constant input and overall transfer efficiency, excluding dynamic limits and outages.
units.verify: 比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。把損失與功率、環境溫度及設備狀態作圖，若差額只在切換時段出現，應先查積分時間與計量路徑。~Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries. Plot loss against power, ambient temperature and equipment state. A discrepancy confined to switching intervals calls for checking integration windows and meter paths before assigning a physical efficiency change.
units.failure: 漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。~Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. These accounting errors can cancel, so agreement in the final total still requires checking the physical boundary of every metered term.
units.misconception: 不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失~Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss.
units.practice: 保持送端電量相同，設定兩種負載效率曲線比較受端電量，再列出換流站與線路應分設哪些電表才能驗證各項損失。~Hold sending energy fixed and compare received energy under two load-dependent efficiency curves. Identify the converter and line meters needed to verify the individual loss components rather than only the final balance.

units.anchor: 無功與視在容量~Reactive power and apparent capacity
units.title: 無功與視在容量~Reactive power and apparent capacity
units.mechanism: 發電機與變壓器的電流負擔同時受實功與無功影響，因此兆伏安額定值不能直接改寫成兆瓦。功率三角形可在平衡正弦穩態下關聯三者，但熱限制與勵磁限制形成的實際能力曲線更複雜。教材先分清量綱，再討論何者是真正限制。 視在功率描述電壓電流乘積，實功才對應平均能量轉移，無功方向則需明示供應或吸收的符號慣例。~Generator and transformer current loading depends on both active and reactive power, so an MVA rating cannot simply be relabeled as MW. The power triangle connects the quantities for balanced sinusoidal steady operation, while thermal and excitation limits make the actual capability curve more complex. Identify quantities before deciding which limit controls. Apparent power describes the voltage-current product, active power represents mean energy transfer, and reactive direction needs an explicit convention for supply versus absorption.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW。模型邊界：平衡正弦穩態且功率因數為實功除視在功率，不表示完整能力曲線。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW. Model boundary: balanced sinusoidal steady state with power factor defined as active divided by apparent power, not a complete capability curve.
units.verify: 同時讀取三相電壓電流、實功與無功，核對功率因數是否依同一基波定義。若總電流增加而實功不變，應查無功及諧波，不立即把它解讀成水輪機提供更多有用機械功率。~Read three-phase voltage, current, active and reactive power together, checking the definition of power factor. If current increases without greater active power, investigate reactive flow and harmonics rather than assuming that the turbine is delivering additional useful mechanical power.
units.failure: 將視在額定值全部當實功，會忽略供應無功時的電流負擔；即使實功低於名目值，過勵磁或冷卻不足仍可能形成限制，需要核對能力曲線與溫度。~Treating the apparent rating entirely as active power ignores current loading while supplying reactive power. Overexcitation or inadequate cooling can constrain operation even below nominal active output, requiring checks of the capability curve and temperatures.
units.misconception: 兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦~An MVA rating can directly be treated as the same numerical MW rating.
units.practice: 固定視在容量計算三種功率因數下的實功與無功，畫功率三角形，再標明哪些設備限制不能由這張三角形推知。~At fixed apparent capacity, calculate active and reactive power for three power factors. Draw their power triangles and identify equipment limits that cannot be inferred from the triangles alone.

units.anchor: 尾水抬升耦合~Tailwater rise coupling
units.title: 尾水抬升耦合~Tailwater rise coupling
units.mechanism: 多台機組向共同尾水河段排放時，增加總流量可能抬高尾水並降低每台機組淨水頭。單機功率因此不一定能線性相加到任意總流量。教材以量測的局部尾水敏感度估算水頭損失，提醒學員同一河段的各機組不是完全獨立的水力設備。 共同尾水河段形成水力耦合，即使電氣母線分開仍會互相影響；模型拓撲應同時保留水路與電路的差異。~Units releasing into a common tailwater reach can raise its level as total discharge increases, reducing net head for each machine. Individual outputs therefore cannot be added linearly at arbitrary aggregate flow. A measured local tailwater sensitivity estimates the head effect and illustrates why machines sharing a reach are not hydraulically independent. A shared tailwater creates hydraulic coupling even with separate electrical buses; model topology should preserve the different connections of the water and electrical systems.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=500 m3/s; k=0.0012 s/m2; dH=k*dQ=0.6 m。模型邊界：局部線性尾水評價，係數僅為假設且不含洪水回水遲滯。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=500 m3/s; k=0.0012 s/m2; dH=k*dQ=0.6 m. Model boundary: local linear tailwater relation with an assumed coefficient, excluding flood backwater hysteresis.
units.verify: 以同步總出流與尾水位建立上升及下降兩條散點路徑，並檢查下游來水是否另有影響。若同流量出現不同尾水，應保留遲滯或邊界條件，不以一條平均直線宣稱機組效率異常。~Plot rising and falling total-flow paths against synchronized tailwater level and check downstream influences. Different levels at the same discharge require retaining hysteresis or boundary conditions rather than forcing one mean line and interpreting the residual as a turbine-efficiency fault.
units.failure: 洪水期間下游控制抬升可能主導尾水，原先低流量線性係數就不再有效；若仍沿用該係數，會高估可用水頭並誤排機組負載。~During flooding, downstream control can dominate tailwater and invalidate a coefficient fitted at low discharge. Continuing to use that coefficient overstates available head and can lead to an inappropriate allocation of generating load among units.
units.misconception: 每台機組出力永遠與其他機組無關~Each unit output is always independent of the other units.
units.practice: 以兩種尾水敏感度比較增加機組後的總功率，指出為何加機組的邊際收益可能下降，再列出需要河道模型處理的情境。~Compare aggregate power after adding units under two tailwater sensitivities. Explain diminishing marginal benefit and identify conditions where a river model is required instead of a local linear relation.

units.anchor: 溢洪水舌動量~Spillway jet momentum
units.title: 溢洪水舌動量~Spillway jet momentum
units.mechanism: 洩洪水舌轉向時，其動量改變需要由導流構造與水體承受反力。教材只取一個水平分量，以質量流率乘速度差建立尺度；實際衝擊力還受壓力、重力及含氣影響。把動量通量與水舌動能分開，才能避免用能量單位直接當載重。 控制體出口角度決定速度分量，速度大小相同而方向改變仍有動量差，應先做向量解析再計算反力。~Turning a spillway jet requires a reaction associated with momentum change. One horizontal component is estimated from mass flow times velocity difference, while real impact also involves pressure, gravity and entrained air. Distinguish momentum flux from kinetic energy so that energy units are not incorrectly treated as structural force. Outlet direction determines velocity components; unchanged speed with a changed direction still produces momentum change, requiring vector resolution before calculating the associated reaction.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN。模型邊界：穩態單一水平動量分量，控制面壓力另假設抵消；非完整消能池載重。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN. Model boundary: steady single horizontal momentum component with boundary pressures assumed to cancel; not a complete stilling-basin load.
units.verify: 先畫控制體標出流入流出方向，量測斷面平均速度而非表面最高速度，再比較壓力與水位所帶來的額外作用。若動量估算與支承反力不同，先檢查遺漏的壓力項，不直接調整流量使兩者吻合。~Draw the control volume and flow directions, use section-average rather than peak surface velocity, and assess additional pressure and level forces. If the momentum estimate differs from measured reaction, examine omitted pressure terms before altering discharge merely to force agreement.
units.failure: 水舌偏流會把反力集中在局部邊牆，總水平力不變也可能增加局部損傷；含氣及脈動又會改變瞬時峰值，因此平均動量不能代替動態載重評估。~A skewed jet concentrates reaction on a sidewall even when total horizontal force is unchanged. Aeration and pulsation also modify instantaneous peaks, so mean momentum does not replace assessment of spatially concentrated dynamic loading.
units.misconception: 水舌動能數值可以直接當結構反力~The numerical jet kinetic energy can directly be used as structural reaction force.
units.practice: 改變出口水舌方向而保持速率，計算水平與垂直動量改變，畫出反力方向，再列出含氣模型試驗需要保持的相似條件。~Change the outlet jet direction at fixed speed, calculate horizontal and vertical momentum changes, and draw reaction directions. Identify similarity conditions needed for an aerated hydraulic model experiment.

units.anchor: 機組冷卻水熱升~Unit cooling water temperature rise
units.title: 機組冷卻水熱升~Unit cooling water temperature rise
units.mechanism: 發電機及軸承損失最終多以熱形式排出，冷卻水流量和溫升共同決定帶走的熱量。教材由已知熱負荷反求理想混合溫升，並區分換熱器端差與水的熱容量。增加冷卻流量不一定解除所有熱點，因接觸熱阻或局部流道堵塞仍可能控制溫度。 量測水溫差通常遠小於絕對溫度，因此成對感測器的差值校準可能比各自絕對精度更影響熱量帳。~Generator and bearing losses largely leave as heat, and cooling-water flow together with temperature rise determines heat removal. Infer an ideal mixed temperature rise from a stated thermal load, distinguishing exchanger approach temperature from water heat capacity. More cooling flow may not remove a hotspot controlled by contact resistance or a blocked local passage. The water temperature rise is often small relative to absolute temperature, so paired differential calibration can matter more than each sensor absolute accuracy for heat accounting.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=8000000 W; mdot=400 kg/s; cp=4180 J/(kg*K); dT=Qheat/(mdot*cp)=4.784688995 K。模型邊界：穩態完全混合且熱負荷全由水帶走，不含對環境散熱。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=8000000 W; mdot=400 kg/s; cp=4180 J/(kg*K); dT=Qheat/(mdot*cp)=4.784688995 K. Model boundary: steady complete mixing with all stated heat carried by water and no ambient loss.
units.verify: 校驗進出口溫度差及水流量，檢查感測器是否位於已混合斷面，再將水側熱量與電機損失估計比較。若總熱量符合而局部繞組升溫，應檢查流道分配與接觸熱阻，而非只增加總流量。~Calibrate inlet-outlet temperature difference and water flow, locating sensors at mixed sections. Compare water-side heat with estimated machine loss. If total heat removal agrees while one winding heats up, investigate flow distribution and contact resistance rather than simply increasing total cooling flow.
units.failure: 換熱管結垢可能提高設備溫度卻不明顯改變總水量，僅監看流量會漏報；溫度感測器安裝在旁通流也會顯示偏低溫升，掩蓋實際熱負荷。~Exchanger fouling can raise equipment temperature without much change in total water flow, escaping flow-only monitoring. A temperature probe in a bypass stream can also indicate an artificially small rise and hide the actual thermal load.
units.misconception: 冷卻水流量正常就保證所有熱點安全~Normal cooling-water flow guarantees that every local hotspot is safe.
units.practice: 令一部分水繞過換熱器，分別計算有效通道與混合出口溫升，說明為何總出口量測可能掩蓋局部過熱，並設計補充測點。~Let part of the water bypass the exchanger. Calculate active-channel and mixed-outlet temperature rises, explain how total-outlet measurements can conceal overheating, and design additional sensing locations.

units.anchor: 轉子激振頻率~Rotor excitation frequency
units.title: 轉子激振頻率~Rotor excitation frequency
units.mechanism: 轉子每轉出現的週期作用會在頻譜形成轉速的整數倍，葉片通過與電磁作用可能具有不同階次。辨識激振頻率先把每分鐘轉數換成每秒，再乘作用次數；頻率接近結構模態只是需要調查的條件，振幅仍取決於激振強度、阻尼及量測方向。 階次追蹤應使用同步轉速訊號，轉速掃描時固定頻率分析窗可能把峰值展寬，造成誤判阻尼增加。~Periodic forces per rotor revolution appear at integer orders of rotational frequency, with blade passage and electromagnetic forces having different orders. Convert revolutions per minute to per second before multiplying by events per turn. Proximity to a structural mode warrants investigation, while amplitude still depends on forcing, damping and measurement direction. Order tracking needs a synchronized speed reference; during a speed sweep, a fixed-frequency analysis window can smear a peak and falsely suggest greater damping.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：n=90 rpm; blades=14; fpass=n/60*blades=21 Hz。模型邊界：理想等距葉片通過頻率，不宣稱該頻率必定共振。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: n=90 rpm; blades=14; fpass=n/60*blades=21 Hz. Model boundary: ideal equally spaced blade-passing frequency, not a claim that resonance necessarily occurs.
units.verify: 同步取得轉速訊號與多方向振動，製作階次圖以區分隨轉速移動的峰值及固定結構頻率。若峰值只在特定水頭增強，應結合壓力脈動判讀，不能單憑頻率相等就確定是機械失衡。~Acquire speed and multidirectional vibration together and create an order map separating speed-dependent peaks from fixed structural frequencies. A peak strengthening only at certain heads calls for pressure-pulsation evidence, rather than identifying mechanical imbalance solely from a frequency match.
units.failure: 感測取樣率不足會把高頻折返成低頻峰，導致錯誤維修方向；只有單軸量測也可能漏掉主要模態，因此需先核對防混疊與測點方向。~Insufficient sampling can alias a high frequency into a low-frequency peak and misdirect maintenance. A single measurement axis may miss the dominant mode, so anti-alias filtering and sensor orientation must be checked before interpreting the spectrum.
units.misconception: 頻率接近就足以證明發生共振~Frequency proximity alone is enough to prove resonance.
units.practice: 對兩種轉速計算葉片通過頻率，畫出與固定模態交會的位置，再設定足夠取樣率，說明尚需哪些振幅與相位證據判斷共振。~Calculate blade-passing frequency at two speeds and mark crossings with a fixed mode. Select a sufficient sampling rate and identify amplitude and phase evidence still needed to diagnose resonance.

units.anchor: 跨境資料時間對齊~Cross border data time alignment
units.title: 跨境資料時間對齊~Cross border data time alignment
units.mechanism: 跨機構水文與電力資料若使用不同時間基準，兩邊各自正確的曲線仍可能在合併後不守恆。對齊時必須辨認時間戳代表區間起點、終點或平均中心，並保存原始時區資訊。教材以固定流量乘時間錯移估計可能被錯配的體積，凸顯資料語義也是工程介面。 區間平均與瞬時樣本不可混用積分規則，時間戳相同仍可能代表不同觀測語義，必須保留欄位定義。~Hydrologic and power records from different institutions can each be correct yet fail conservation after merging if time conventions differ. Determine whether timestamps mark interval starts, ends or centers and retain original time-zone information. Flow times an offset estimates misassigned volume and shows that data semantics form an engineering interface. Interval averages and instantaneous samples require different integration treatment; matching timestamps can still represent different observation meanings, so field definitions must accompany the data.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=2500 m3/s; dt=15 min; Vmis=Q*dt*60=2250000 m3。模型邊界：固定流量下的時段錯配體積，不是實際漏水或永久庫容損失。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=2500 m3/s; dt=15 min; Vmis=Q*dt*60=2250000 m3. Model boundary: volume assigned to the wrong interval at constant flow, not physical leakage or permanent storage loss.
units.verify: 以同一測站的原始記錄和匯總記錄核對時間戳定義，使用明確時區轉成統一時間後再積分。把尖峰事件作為對齊檢查，若總日量相同但時段殘差很大，先查時間位移而非創造額外水源項。~Check timestamp definitions against raw and aggregated records from one station, convert explicit time zones to a common basis, and then integrate. Use identifiable peaks for alignment. Equal daily totals with large interval residuals suggest a time shift before an additional physical water source.
units.failure: 系統自動套用錯誤夏令時間規則會讓資料跳一小時，且日總量可能仍看似合理；缺測補值若未加旗標，也會讓跨境比較誤判為真實調度差異。~An incorrect automatic daylight-saving rule can shift data by an hour while daily totals still look plausible. Unflagged imputation can likewise make a cross-border comparison mistake reconstructed values for a real difference in dispatch behavior.
units.misconception: 日總量吻合就保證每小時資料對齊~Matching daily totals guarantees that hourly records are aligned.
units.practice: 建立一條洪水尖峰曲線並將另一份資料錯移十五分鐘，比較日量與時段殘差，再寫出可重現的時間欄位規格與缺測旗標。~Create a flood-peak series and shift a second copy by fifteen minutes. Compare daily volume and interval residuals, then specify reproducible timestamp fields and flags for missing or reconstructed values.

units.anchor: 機組輪替可用時數~Unit rotation available hours
units.title: 機組輪替可用時數~Unit rotation available hours
units.mechanism: 定期檢修以台時表示能區分停機數量與時間，卻不能直接等同失去的發電量。機組輪替可能在水量不足期間安排，部分停機因而不減少實際出力；相反地，共同設備停機可能影響所有機組。先算可用台時，再與逐時可用水量和輸電能力配對。 計畫停機與強迫停機可有不同管理目的，但在某時段都會限制可用設備；比較前應把分類與物理狀態分開。~Unit-hours distinguish outage count from duration but do not directly equal lost energy. Maintenance during water-limited periods may leave actual output unchanged, whereas shared-equipment outages can affect every unit. Calculate available unit-hours first and then pair them with hourly water availability and transmission capability. Planned and forced outages have different management meanings but both constrain equipment in an interval; separate classification from physical availability before comparing schedules.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N=10 units; T=24 h; nout=2 units; tout=6 h; A=N*T-nout*tout=228 unit*h。模型邊界：只計假想設備可用台時，不計功率或水量限制。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=10 units; T=24 h; nout=2 units; tout=6 h; A=N*T-nout*tout=228 unit*h. Model boundary: hypothetical equipment availability hours only, excluding power and water constraints.
units.verify: 用事件紀錄核對每部機組停機開始與恢復時間，區分計畫檢修、故障及外部限制。再與逐時發電和來水比較，若可用台時減少而能量不變，需檢查原本是否受水量限制，而非假定紀錄錯誤。~Reconcile each unit outage and restoration with event logs, distinguishing maintenance, failures and external restrictions. Compare hourly generation and inflow. Reduced available unit-hours with unchanged energy may indicate water-limited operation rather than an error in the equipment records.
units.failure: 把待命未發電記為設備故障會低估可用率，反之只看機械可動也會漏掉電氣外送限制；不同可用率定義不能在未說明邊界時直接排名。~Treating idle standby as equipment failure understates availability, while mechanical readiness alone overlooks electrical export restrictions. Availability metrics with different definitions cannot be ranked directly without explaining their boundaries and what each unavailable state includes.
units.misconception: 可用台時減少一定等比例減少發電量~Reduced available unit-hours always reduce generation by the same proportion.
units.practice: 比較同樣損失十二台時但安排在高流量與低流量時段的情境，建立簡化發電表，指出哪種條件下兩者實際能量損失不同。~Compare two schedules losing twelve unit-hours during high-flow and low-flow periods. Build a simplified generation table and identify conditions under which the schedules produce different actual energy losses.

units.anchor: 閘門驅動功率~Gate drive power requirement
units.title: 閘門驅動功率~Gate drive power requirement
units.mechanism: 閘門驅動需要克服水力作用、門重及摩擦，但水流通過閘孔的水力功率並不全由啟閉機提供。教材使用已知提升力與速度估算電端需求，並把啟動峰值、制動和結構反力另列。力的取得應來自明確載重組合，不能由總洩洪量任意換算。 提升力可能隨門位改變，完整動作能量需沿行程積分力，固定力乘行程只適用於明示的簡化情境。~A gate drive overcomes hydraulic effects, weight and friction, but it does not supply all hydraulic power passing through the opening. Estimate electrical demand from a stated lifting force and speed, separating startup peaks, braking and structural reaction. The force must come from a defined load combination rather than an arbitrary conversion of spill discharge. Lifting force can vary with position, so complete travel energy integrates force along displacement; constant force times travel applies only to the declared simplified case.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：F=1600000 N; v=0.015 m/s; eta=0.75 (dimensionless); P=F*v/eta=32000 W。模型邊界：已知恆定提升力與速度，不含啟動峰值及不平衡吊點。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: F=1600000 N; v=0.015 m/s; eta=0.75 (dimensionless); P=F*v/eta=32000 W. Model boundary: known constant lifting force and speed, excluding startup peaks and unequal lifting points.
units.verify: 同步比較啟閉電流、位移速度與兩側吊點力，檢查門體是否偏斜及摩擦是否隨方向改變。若功率高而位移低，應查卡阻與制動未釋放；不能只靠額定馬達容量推定閘門能正常動作。~Compare drive current, movement speed and forces at both lifting points, checking skew and direction-dependent friction. High power with little movement suggests binding or an unreleased brake; nameplate motor capacity alone does not establish that the gate can perform its intended movement.
units.failure: 一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。~Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force. Lubrication cannot correct geometric misalignment, so the source of unequal loading must be identified before choosing a maintenance response.
units.misconception: 啟閉機需提供通過閘孔的全部水力功率~The gate drive must supply all hydraulic power flowing through the opening.
units.practice: 把提升速度減半而力保持不變，重算功率與動作時間，再加入不對稱吊點荷載，說明總功率計算為何不能驗證門體抗扭能力。~Halve lifting speed at unchanged force and recalculate power and travel time. Add unequal lifting-point loads and explain why the total power calculation cannot verify the gate resistance to twisting.
